english:
Conjures a Healing Rift beneath you that lasts 15 seconds and heals you and allies within 5 meters for <pve 40 /> <pvp [35] /> HP per second.

At full health, the Rift generates 3 Overshield HP per second, up to 15 Overshield HP. Void Overshield prevents this.

Overshield from the Rift stacks with other Overshields, such as <exotic Turnabout />'s or those from Class Stats, and layers are determined First In, First Out.

Standing in a friendly Healing Rift counts you as having an Overshield for perk interactions.

The placement animation grants 20% Damage Resistance and allows movement at ? m/s.

While at Full Health | Healing Rift generates 3 Overshield HP per second, up to 15 Overshield HP. Having Void Overshield prevents this from happening.
Overshield can stack with other overshields, such as Turnabout's OS and Class Stat OS. Overshield layers are determined by "First In, First Out".
Healing Rifts cause the users to count as having Overshields for the purpose of perk interactions.

Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.
